title: Galaxy stuck in bootloop
shortDescription: Phone restarts at Samsung logo repeatedly.
fullDescription: A Galaxy bootloop occurs when the device cannot complete the Android boot process. It hangs at the Samsung logo, restarts, and repeats indefinitely. Common causes include failed system updates, third-party apps that crash on boot, root issues, and corrupted data partitions.

fixSteps.title: Boot to Safe Mode
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, power on, when Samsung logo appears hold Volume Down until home screen.

fixSteps.title: Wipe cache partition
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, hold Volume Up + Power + Bixby (or Side button). At Recovery menu, choose 'Wipe cache partition'.

fixSteps.title: Factory reset
fixSteps.instruction: From Recovery, choose 'Wipe data/factory reset'. Erases all data.

fixSteps.title: Re-flash firmware via Odin
fixSteps.instruction: Use Odin tool with stock firmware from Samfirm. Advanced.

faq.a: Cache wipe doesn't, factory reset does.

title: Galaxy blue screen of death
shortDescription: Phone shows blue screen and reboots.
fullDescription: Some Galaxy phones (notably S20/S21 series) suffer from a 'blue screen of death' where the screen flashes blue and the device reboots randomly. Often caused by Samsung's own firmware bugs or display drivers, sometimes by hardware (One UI / display panel issue).

fixSteps.title: Samsung service
fixSteps.instruction: If display panel fault, replacement under warranty.

videoSearchQuery: Samsung Galaxy blue screen of death fix

faq.a: Similar concept — system fault triggers reboot.

title: Emergency calls only
shortDescription: Phone refuses to register on carrier.
fullDescription: Galaxy displays 'Emergency calls only' or 'No SIM' when it cannot authenticate with the carrier. Causes range from SIM issue to IMEI corruption to baseband failure.

fixSteps.title: Reseat SIM
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and reinsert SIM card. Try in another phone to verify it works.

fixSteps.title: Reset Network Settings
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > General management > Reset > Reset network settings.

fixSteps.title: Manually select operator
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Connections > Mobile networks > Network operators > Search.

title: com.android.systemui has stopped
shortDescription: System UI crashed - status bar / notification panel.
fullDescription: This error pops repeatedly, especially after software updates or installing themes. The System UI (status bar, navigation, notifications) crashes and respawns immediately.

fixSteps.title: Clear cache for SystemUI
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Apps > sort by all, find System UI, Storage > Clear cache.

title: Moisture detected in charging port
shortDescription: Galaxy refuses to charge - water in port.
fullDescription: Galaxy phones display 'Moisture detected' warning when the USB-C port detects water or even just humidity. Charging is blocked to prevent damage. The warning often persists after the port has dried due to humidity sensor sensitivity.

fixSteps.title: Air dry port
fixSteps.instruction: Place phone with USB port facing down for 30 minutes in dry place. Avoid heat, rice, hairdryer.

fixSteps.title: Wireless charging
fixSteps.instruction: Use wireless charger to bypass port. Battery will help dry by warming.

fixSteps.title: Force stop USBSettings
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Apps > USBSettings > Storage > Clear data. Resets the warning.

fixSteps.title: Replace charging port
fixSteps.instruction: If corroded, replace USB-C port flex.

faq.a: No, dust enters and makes it worse.

title: Warning: Camera failed
shortDescription: Galaxy camera app crashes on launch.
fullDescription: Galaxy displays 'Warning: Camera failed' when the camera service crashes. Often caused by third-party apps holding camera, cache issues, or hardware failure of the rear camera module.

fixSteps.title: Force stop camera + clear cache
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Apps > Camera > Storage > Clear cache.

fixSteps.title: Replace camera module
fixSteps.instruction: Open phone, replace rear camera assembly.

faq.a: Sometimes — verify camera permission for apps.

title: Fast charging not working
shortDescription: Galaxy charges slowly even with fast charger.
fullDescription: Galaxy phones support Adaptive Fast Charging (AFC), Super Fast Charging (USB PD PPS). When using a non-PPS charger, generic cable, or with Adaptive setting off, phone charges slowly.

fixSteps.title: Enable fast charging
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Battery > More battery settings > toggle Fast charging / Super fast charging on.

fixSteps.title: Use Samsung charger
fixSteps.instruction: Use 25W or 45W Samsung-branded USB PD PPS charger and 5A cable.

whenToCallPro: If charger and cable verified working.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung fast charging not working fix

title: Pink or red screen tint
shortDescription: Galaxy display shows pink or red cast.
fullDescription: Galaxy AMOLED panels can develop pink or red tint, sometimes after software updates, sometimes due to panel aging. May be fixable via display calibration in settings.

fixSteps.title: Adjust white balance
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Display > Screen mode > Vivid > White balance — slide toward green.

title: Fingerprint sensor not working
fullDescription: Galaxy under-display ultrasonic fingerprint sensors can fail to recognize fingerprints reliably, especially with screen protectors, dirty screens, or cold/dry skin.

fixSteps.title: Use approved screen protector
fixSteps.instruction: Use Samsung's officially recommended ultrasonic-compatible protector or no protector.

fixSteps.title: Re-register fingerprints
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Biometrics > Fingerprints > delete all and re-register.

fixSteps.title: Calibrate touch sensitivity
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Display > Touch sensitivity ON for screen protectors.

faq.a: Some yes, especially Whitestone Dome or Samsung-approved.

title: Galaxy won't charge at all
fullDescription: Galaxy refuses any charging — wired or wireless. Possible deeply-discharged battery, broken USB-C port, or failed charging IC.

fixSteps.title: Charge for 30 min
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in original charger, leave 30 minutes before checking.

fixSteps.title: Try wireless charging
fixSteps.instruction: If supported, place on wireless charger.

title: Phone overheating warning
shortDescription: Galaxy refuses to operate due to high temperature.
fullDescription: Galaxy displays 'Cool down phone before using' or shuts off when internal temperature exceeds threshold. Often during charging in hot environment, gaming, or with bad battery.

fixSteps.title: Remove case, cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Place phone in cool (not cold) environment, remove case to dissipate heat.

fixSteps.title: Disable 5G / lower brightness
fixSteps.instruction: 5G drains/heats more — try LTE only when not needed.

fixSteps.title: Replace battery
fixSteps.instruction: Battery can swell or degrade — replace.

title: Knox warranty void (0x1)
fullDescription: Once a custom kernel or rooted firmware is flashed, the Knox eFuse blows permanently, voiding warranty and disabling Samsung Pay, Secure Folder, etc. Status changes from 0x0 to 0x1.

fixSteps.title: Re-flash stock firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Using Odin, flash stock firmware with CSC. Removes root but Knox status remains 0x1.

whenToCallPro: Knox cannot be reverted by anyone.
